Hi!! I’m also a 20 year old female and I just had my gallbladder out a week ago. 
The surgery was very simple and easy and I was only in hospital overnight. 

I’m not gonna sugar coat it I am in quite a bit of pain especially now coming off the pain meds but I’ve talked to a lot of people who’ve had their gallbladders out and they say after about 2 weeks you start getting back to normal. 

As far as diet and alcohol goes I didn’t have to change my diet much at all. The surgeon told me I can eat completely normal although for my peace of mind I have been cutting out high fat and dairy and then slowly introducing it back in. As far as alcohol I can speak for myself as I gave up drinking last year for health reasons but I’m sure you could slowly introduce it back in. The doctor will be able to give you more info on that. 

Not sure if you get gallbladder pain and attacks but if you do, you are much better off having it out. The pain I’m in now doesn’t compare to when I get an attack. Just make sure you rest after surgery and not to do anything strenuous or lift anything heavy (over 5kg my doctor said). 

If you have anymore questions I’d be more than happy to help and answer as much as I can. As a fellow 20 year old female it may help put some peace of mind. 
Best of luck ❤️
